text: What if I had skipped that second coffee?

steps.title: Tonight without it
steps.say: Without that cup, your alertness at 23:00 would be noticeably lower. Caffeine would be mostly gone from your morning coffee.

steps.title: Bedtime
steps.say: With the second coffee, about three times more caffeine would still be in your blood at bedtime. Skipping it means you may feel sleepy sooner.

lines.text: Without that cup you would be a lot less wired tonight, and sleepier around 23:00.
Caffeine in your blood at bedtime would be about a third of what it is now.
You may feel sleepy sooner and fall asleep more easily.
